records.title: PeakBench: Benchmarking Resource-Aware Tool Invocation in LLM Agents
records.reason: The target is tool-execution orchestration and capacity overflow, not model-token inference, model serving, or LLM-generation cost. Its relevance to the project’s inference-efficiency scope is adjacent and weak.

records.title: EviDx: Evidence-Aware Active Diagnosis with Scaffolded LLM Agents
records.reason: Primary abstract proposes evidence-seeking clinical diagnosis with LLM agents, without an inference/serving-efficiency method.

records.title: Quantization Effects on Bangla Language Understanding in Large Language Models: A Systematic Evaluation
records.reason: This is a language- and model-specific evaluation of existing quantizers, not a new inference-efficiency method; the transferability and deployment-performance evidence are limited.

records.title: Cross-Layer Analysis of Thermal Tuning Stalls in Wafer-Scale Optical Interconnects for LLM MoE Training
records.reason: Primary abstract studies optical interconnect thermal tuning for LLM MoE training, explicitly a training communication bottleneck.

records.title: EviGraph: Towards Verifiable Evidence Construction for Information-Seeking Agents
records.reason: Primary abstract focuses on evidence provenance and verifiable information-seeking-agent answers; no inference-cost or serving optimization is claimed.
